claude.take: Numerically the most attractive of the six: 14.0x FY26 earnings, RoNW 32.24%, RoCE 27.13%, and a ₹7,953 Cr order book worth 2.2 years of revenue — priced at a 27% discount to Enviro Infra Engineers, which earns half the return on equity. The market is discounting real things, though. LCC was incorporated only in 2017 and has never traded through an infrastructure down-cycle; 83% of the book is government irrigation work, so receivables and political tender cycles drive the cash conversion; and ₹1,818 Cr of borrowings shrinks by only ₹180 Cr from the IPO. The pre-listing share-count expansion that dropped reported EPS from ₹17.00 to ₹10.42 while PAT rose is worth confirming in the RHP before trusting the 14x. A sole BRLM on a ₹427 Cr issue is also thinner distribution than the multi-banker names opening the same day.
